name: oauth-consent-react
title: OAuth Consent for React
description: OAuth 2.1 consent component for an existing authenticated application.
docs:
After installation, merge the following into `supabase/config.toml`; do not replace an existing file:

```toml
[auth.oauth_server]
enabled = true
authorization_url_path = "/oauth/consent"
```

You'll need to set the following environment variables in your project: `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` and `VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
